text:
emma.exec: Quick internal note: we're soft-launching Dedicated L80X + H200P in ap-southeast-4 (brisbane) today. This is a controlled release, not GA. Please read the rollout constraints below. :sparkles:

ops-bot: Controlled release details posted. Two-week evaluation window. Reservations for new customers are paused; existing Dedicated customers can request migration via the capacity form. https://redwood.company/capacity-request

rachel.prod: Why brisbane? Lower median RTT for APAC customers and closer to our partner POP. L80X is our new L-series GPU optimized for int8-friendly quant workflows 1. Bench highlights: ~20-25% token cost reduction on long context workloads vs A100X when using our recommended quant profile. H200P is offered in the same pool for low-latency p95 use-cases.

jorge-sre: Infra notes: initial canary is 10 racks. We'll expand to 40 racks only if nvlink error rate stays <0.1% and kernel OOMs are flat. We'll be streaming an ops dashboard with per-node nvlink and GPU-util metrics. Expect a short live-patch tonight (00:45-01:15 UTC) to push kernel nvlink backports. No Dedicated job restarts expected due to livepatching.

nina-sales: Heads-up: please include an embargoed blurb for sales so we can speak with strategic accounts. Also need the temporary pricing uplift and reservation policy to share with EMEA/APAC reps.

rachel.prod: Pricing/billing: L80X will be billed under L-series SKU. Intro period: +10% APAC regional premium for 21 days. No change to Dedicated reservation minimums, but quota increases require the capacity request form and approval.

sam-support: Support playbook: if a customer reports degraded p95 we should: 1) collect model id + seq len + tokens/sample, 2) ask for route + model variant, 3) escalate to #eng-runtime if nvlink or kernel OOMs shown in dashboard. I'll update the runbook and tag support tickets with "brisbane-l80x" prefix.

jorge-sre: Rolling plan summary: (A) 0-24h: internal + partner beta on 10 racks, (B) 24-72h: incremental expand to 40 racks if health OK, (C) 72h+: open for wider Dedicated reservations. If any of these steps fail health gates, we rollback to the prior capacity snapshot.

emma.exec: Policy note: due to limited initial capacity we are applying a two-week reservation hold for new accounts; renewals and enterprise migrations are allowed case-by-case. Leadership will re-evaluate after the canary window.

ops-bot: Quick example for canary testing (use with appropriate creds): ```bash
# run a test container targeting the L80X pool
redwoodctl run --region ap-southeast-4 --gpu L80X --cpus 12 --image company/infer:latest --env MODEL=redwood-large
```

nina-sales: Can we get a one-pager for reps with timelines + sample pricing? Rachel, can you drop that in the sales-docs repo by EOD?

rachel.prod: Yep sending draft in 2h. Will include perf numbers, billing SKUs, and migration instructions.

sam-support: I'll pre-seed canned responses for customers impacted by the reservation hold.

ops-bot: If you need a reservation exception, include customer id, expected QPS, and preferred start date on the capacity form and tag #capacity. Reactions: :rocket: :australia:
